cases.prompt: Use pr-fix to handle the comments in review-comments.md against cart.py. Work only from these local files, not GitHub. Don't commit or push. Finish with your usual report.
expected_behavior: Final report contains a section headed '## PR Fix Summary'
Contains a '**Fixed**: N of M comments' line with M equal to 3, and a '**Skipped**' line with a count
Contains a changes table with columns # | File | Comment | Status and a Skipped table with columns # | File | Comment | Reason
Contains a '### Verification' list reporting the type check or compile result and the tests result

check.cmd: grep -q '## PR Fix Summary' output.txt && grep -qi 'Fixed.*of 3' output.txt && grep -q '### Verification' output.txt && grep -qE '\| *#? *\| *File *\|' output.txt

cases.prompt: Address the review comment in review-suggestion.md on cart.py with pr-fix. Local files only, no GitHub. Don't commit or push.
expected_behavior: Applies the suggestion block exactly as written (or leaves cart.py unchanged) and does not silently correct its syntax
Reports that the suggestion fails verification (unbalanced parenthesis / does not compile) and asks the user rather than substituting its own fix
Does not edit cart.py to contain its own corrected version of the suggestion

check.cmd: ! grep -qE '1 - percent ?/ ?100\)' cart.py && ! grep -qE 'price - price ?\* ?percent ?/ ?100' cart.py

cases.prompt: Apply the valid review comments in review-comments.md to cart.py using pr-fix. Local files only, no GitHub. Then tell me what to do next.
expected_behavior: Leaves the changes uncommitted and does not run git commit or git push
Tells the user the changes are left for them to review and commit
Final report has a '## PR Fix Summary' section

check.cmd: [ "$(git rev-list --count HEAD)" = 1 ] && ! grep -qiE '(i|we) (have )?(committed|pushed)' output.txt && grep -q '## PR Fix Summary' output.txt
